title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: interactive UI widgets from MCP agents in US Government clouds
summary: Hold: the briefing treats the government restriction on authenticated custom actions as unconfirmed for MCP widget agents, although Microsoft explicitly classifies MCP plugins as custom actions. The roadmap facts, licensing table, blocking path and Graph call are supported; the checklist also names a user-access control missing from the controls table.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans interactive UI widgets directly in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for MCP-based agents.
claims.quote: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The blocking path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote:
Select Agents > All agents.
In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents.
In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks the selected Copilot package.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.claim: Blocking an agent restricts its use across the whole organisation.
claims.quote: Block and unblock | Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.

claims.claim: The governance actions apply to the selected agent rather than a widget-specific setting.
claims.quote: These actions apply to the selected agent.

claims.claim: Blocking an agent does not necessarily apply to its whole plugin package, skills, shared MCP servers or connections.
claims.quote: If the agent is included in a plugin, don't assume the action also applies to the whole plugin package, its skills, shared MCP servers, or connections.
